pages.text: In the middle of a fight it can be difficult take the time to eat some food. Or you run out of food while exploring a large cave. $(br)In both situations a Hunger Protection Poppet will come in handy. Once your food level falls below a certain point it will automatically fill your belly for you.

pages.title: Uses and Effects
pages.text: Five uses. Checks every 5 seconds; at 10 food points (five drumsticks) or fewer, grants Saturation II for 60 seconds. Also protects against starvation damage.
